t: The Bristan Quest 110mm cloakroom basin pillar taps are a practical and stylish choice for bathroom installations. Made from durable brass with a chrome finish, designed for reliability and to suit various settings, including cloakrooms and ensuites. Featuring 1/4 turn lever operation, they offer precise water flow control, with integrated ceramic disc technology to ensure long-lasting performance. Suitable for both high and low-pressure plumbing systems, these deck-mounted pillar taps provide a robust solution for new installations and refurbishment projects.
b: Suitable for High & Low Pressure Systems
